sum: AVAX One Technology Ltd., a digital infrastructure company, builds modular data centers to deliver cost-efficient compute capacity for AI and high-performance computing workloads. It also mines Bitcoin in Alberta and Ohio; and maintains a strategic Avalanche digital asset treasury, accumulating AVAX and generating onchain yield through native staking and ecosystem participation. The company was formerly known as AgriFORCE Growing Systems Ltd. and changed its name to Avax One Technology Ltd. in November 2025. Avax One Technology Ltd. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida.
ceo: Mr. Peter  Wylie Jr. (Interim CEO & COO)
